sourceSentences: Renata fires a hook in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and roots them for 1 second
Renata forms a tether between her and the target for the same duration, causing Renata to become unable to declare attacks and have her movement speed reduced by 30%.

Recast: Renata breaks the tether to knock the target in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing the same damage to enemies they pass through. If the thrown target is a champion, all secondary targets hit are stunned for 0.5 seconds.
Renata's basic attacks are empowered to apply a mark that lasts 6 seconds, refreshes on subsequent hits and expires when attacking a new enemy.
Allied champions damaging attacks and abilities against a marked target will consume the mark to deal additional bonus magic damage
If the target takes fatal damage while Bailout is active, they are restored to 100% of their maximum health but suffer a true damage burn
The burn will stop once the target scores a takedown against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them, setting their current health to 20% of their maximum health immediately afterwards.
If Bailout is cast on a target that is already burning from a previous Bailout cast, they can trigger a subsequent health restore as well as be inflicted with another burn.
Within their targeting radius, they prioritize attacking the closest unit by the following categories in descending order: Their allied champions, Allied non-champions, Allied wards, Enemy units
At level two, your E and Q is an amazing trade combo being able to shield your team while damaging and slowing the enemy team
Follow up with ult into E, and then attack away using W on whoever needs it. And your engage combo is the ultimate into flash and Q before following up with E and more attacks.
if there were no other enemies nearby, they can go for you.
E Q: First, you use your E to slow the enemy, then
Q E Q. During the second and a half, you throw your E and then pull them towards it so they get hit.
When you cast your Q at something that isn't a champion and try to throw it, you don't stun the enemy champion.
But unfortunately you can't push them through the wall. You can combine Flash with her 'Q' to close the gap.
When you're up against only one enemy, don't use your ultimate if there are no enemy minions or wards nearby because you'll die faster.
Once you reach level 6, the basic combo to engage is R-E-Q-AA-W-AA
